about: Probe results of the L4 research collection (probes/): behaviours nobody has confirmed on hardware (docs/LEVELS.md). Each probe ROM is demo code run under an l4- name (acc-dual and acc-split-* from the Elevane l3 demos, the others from Corvane, l4-acc-rear-plane, l4-vcount-write, l4-tex-late and the six l4-3d-ram-* probes written for this collection); it writes a result block at 0x0237F000 at frame 120 (ten probes, the l4-3d-ram-* probes among them, finish earlier, as soon as their measurement is done: probes/docs/QA.md; magic CVER, FNV-1a of the demo name, frame, values[13]). The items are informational: they never fail a run. `known.<profile>.observed` records what each emulator gave per item; tools/judge.py --profile exits 1 when an emulator no longer matches its record (a change is news). The `expect`/`min`/`max` fields are the reference value of the item (the value the emulators gave when the probe was written, or the value the behaviour is expected to have); they are never a hardware value and the per-emulator record under `known` is what the judge compares.

sources.unconfirmed: no hardware value yet; informational only, never fails the run (with --profile the recorded observation is compared)

checks.eq: values[i] == expect (an item with several indexes records all of them under `known`; the reference is compared with the first)
checks.same: all values equal (two or more indexes)
checks.na_when: [i, v]: the item is n/a when values[i] == v (the emulator has no such counter; DeSmuME reads 0 for the polygon counters)
checks.not_value: item field: the item fails when any of its values equals it (0xFFFF = capture did not finish)
